root_cause: Exact production and affected-route readback were healthy, but the pricing browser proof produced sequential Playwright locator false negatives: scrollIntoViewIfNeeded timed out, then locator waitFor visible timed out, and after readiness recovery locator.boundingBox timed out for 30 seconds. The canonical HTML/CSS contains exactly one loss-stage control and mobile lifecycle tabs are rendered as a visible grid. The failure class is locator auto-wait/geometry instability, not missing production content. A fourth production replay proved that locator.evaluate also participates in Playwright locator auto-wait: exact production 984f6795 was ready, routes were healthy, but lossButton.evaluate timed out waiting for [data-bg-stage="loss"].
prevention_rule: After the product-specific ready-v3 marker, do not use a Playwright Locator for lifecycle geometry/actionability at all. Query the element directly inside page.evaluate with document.querySelector, return explicit missing/visibility/geometry state, scroll and re-read geometry through page.evaluate, then preserve a real page.mouse.click. Genuine missing, hidden, transparent or zero-sized controls remain fail-closed. Do not use locator waitFor, boundingBox, scrollIntoViewIfNeeded, locator.evaluate, force:true or DOM click shortcuts for this proof. Regression contracts must assert interaction semantics (ready marker, visible geometry, real pointer, state transition), never obsolete locator implementation details.

failed_runs.failure: locator.evaluate TimeoutError waiting for [data-bg-stage="loss"] after exact production identity was proven

invariants: pricing ready-v3 marker remains the domain-specific readiness authority
genuinely hidden or zero-sized lifecycle controls fail closed
production interaction proof uses direct DOM geometry plus a real page.mouse pointer event
lifecycle selection billing mutation and English-route semantic assertions remain mandatory
pricing lifecycle actionability proof does not use Playwright Locator evaluation for the loss control

failed_approaches: Legacy pricing actionability tests encoded retired locator-level primitives after the canonical verifier moved to direct DOM geometry and page.mouse.click, producing false CI failures despite a correct verifier.
